messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx rate detected for tenant=overseer-prod in VPC us-west-2 (dedicated pool dp-07). Error rate 12% over baseline 0.5% — tracing started.
sara: seeing it. dashboard shows latency spike and model failures for /v1/chat. Customer support page already opened.
dan: digging into logs — it looks like KV cache thrash after a tail-latency regression on model variant 'overseer-gpt-2.1'. getting OOM resets on worker-3.
eva: confirmed OOMs on gpu-node-23, evicting from pool. traffic still routing. Isolate tenant?
mike: recommend immediate tenant pin to safe variant to stop evictions: target model 'overseer-gpt-2.1-safe-v1' which is quantized and lower mem.
sara: agree. who can run the pin now? we need minimal downtime.
arnold-oncall: I'm on pager, taking lead. I'll do coordinated pin + routing frictionless fallback. @dan leave me console access steps. :pager:
dan: arnold — run this quick command from ops jump host:```redwoodctl tenant-set-model --tenant overseer-prod --model overseer-gpt-2.1-safe-v1 --mode pin --reason "emergency safevariant pin due to gpu OOMs" --skip-traffic-shift=false``` That will pin and route 100% after canary by default (can set --canary-percent).
arnold-oncall: executing canary at 10% first. running: ```redwoodctl tenant-set-model --tenant overseer-prod --model overseer-gpt-2.1-safe-v1 --mode pin --canary 10```
incident-bot: Deploy job started by arnold-oncall: job_id=job-98765, canary=10%. Notifying routing service.
eva: monitoring logs and KPIs — initial canary shows error rate down to 1.2% on canary segment, latency improved ~30ms. good sign.
sara: open a message for the customer-facing team to prepare a status update: "We are actively mitigating elevated errors by routing to a lower-memory safe variant; no data loss; investigating root cause."
mike: we should also add a temporary derate policy to prevent bursty KV cache writes: `config set pool dp-07 kv_cache_write_qps=2000`
d an: (typo) dan: +1 on derate. I'll push policy change now.
dan: policy applied. kv write QPS limited, reduced memory churn.
arnold-oncall: ramping canary from 10% -> 50% over 6 minutes. running: `redwoodctl rollout-canary --job job-98765 --target 50 --step 30s`
incident-bot: Rollout progressing: 10% -> 50% (3m). Metrics alert cleared for canary slice.
eva: at 50% the error rate overall is now 0.6%. staying stable. node restarts have stopped.
sara: customer impact assessment: 2.3% of requests experienced errors during the window 3259989400-3259990000. No PII exposure. Ops ticket created CT-4421 for postmortem.
mike: next steps: keep pinned safe variant for 24 hours, add model regression test to canary suite, schedule infra debug for node-23 memory leak.
arnold-oncall: I'll hand off to @eva for overnight watch and postmortem writeup. eva — you're owning the follow-ups?
eva: taking it. will document timeline and action items. prepping postmortem draft now.
sara: thanks team — close on-call if things stable 1 hour after full rollout. :thumbsup:
arnold-oncall: closing lead. leaving pin in place. If customer requests model rollback, coordinate with PM and security.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> monitoring. ticket=INC-2026, severity=2.
